rationale: The PDF hash and source location were verified. The blind translation accurately describes an exact gamma_{n-1} theorem for left-to-right summation of nonnegative real inputs under an abstract addition model. The cited paper result instead analyzes unshifted exponential evaluation followed by recursive summation, distinguishes three sum quantities, and derives indexed first-order absolute bounds culminating in an (n+1)us+O(u^2) aggregate result. Because each statement omits or changes essential content needed by the other, neither implication holds and the translation is not-faithful-different.
